description: Google Trends interest over time for a keyword. Returns Google Trends search interest as a dated series indexed 0-100: weekly points across the default past 12 months, daily points for 30- and 90-day windows, and windows from the past hour back to 2004, with optional country targeting. For keyword trend analysis, search demand seasonality, and SEO keyword research. [$0.05/call]. Params — keyword: the search term to chart; geo: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, GB, DE, JP (213 countries supported); omit for worldwide; timeframe: time window. Each response reports its own bucket size in `granularity`: past_30_days and past_90_days return a daily series, past_12_months and past_5_years weekly, windows under a day hourly (2004_present|past_12_months|past_30_days|past_4_hours|past_5_years|past_7_days|past_90_days|past_day|past_hour) Example params: {'keyword': 'bitcoin', 'geo': 'US'}
name: trend
